name: Windrose
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The PvE pirate survival adventure: sail, fight, build and explore with up to 10 players. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated; players join with an invite code.
startup: pp=false; [ -n "$SERVER_PASSWORD" ] && pp=true; sed -i -E "s/(\"IsPasswordProtected\": *)(true|false|\"true\"|\"false\")/\1$pp/; s/(\"UseDirectConnection\": *)(true|false|\"true\"|\"false\")/\1{{USE_DIRECT_CONNECTION}}/" R5/ServerDescription.json; rm -f "R5/Saved/Logs/R5.log"; tail -n +1 -F "R5/Saved/Logs/R5.log" 2>/dev/null & (trap - INT TERM; exec wine ./R5/Binaries/Win64/WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log) & pid=$!; trap '(sleep 60; kill -TERM $pid 2>/dev/null) &' INT TERM; wait $pid; r=$?; while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do wait $pid; r=$?; done; wineserver -w 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; exit $r

config.startup: {"done": "regex:UEngine::LoadMap Load map complete|Bringing up level for play took"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Windrose. Installs or updates the Windows dedicated server (Steam app
# 4129620) with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Worlds and
# ServerDescription.json are never touched, once written.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-4129620}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server's settings (R5/ServerDescription.json), written once so the
# Panel can set its keys from the first start; the server fills in the rest.
mkdir -p R5
if [ ! -f R5/ServerDescription.json ]; then
    cat > R5/ServerDescription.json <<'JSON'
{
    "Version": 1,
    "DeploymentId": "",
    "ServerDescription_Persistent": {
        "PersistentServerId": "",
        "InviteCode": "",
        "IsPasswordProtected": false,
        "Password": "",
        "ServerName": "A Windrose server",
        "WorldIslandId": "",
        "MaxPlayerCount": 4,
        "UserSelectedRegion": "",
        "P2pProxyAddress": "0.0.0.0",
        "UseDirectConnection": false,
        "DirectConnectionServerAddress": "",
        "DirectConnectionServerPort": 7777,
        "DirectConnectionProxyAddress": "0.0.0.0",
        "AutoLoadLatestBackupIfHasBroken": true
    }
}
JSON
fi
echo "Installed Windrose build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see when they join.

variables.name: Invite code
variables.description: The code players join with: 6 to 32 letters and digits, case-sensitive. Empty, the server makes one up.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once; 4 runs best.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: The region the server says it's in: SEA, CIS or EU, or empty to let it choose.

variables.name: Direct connection
variables.description: true lets players join by address and port instead of the invite code.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine logging
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.
